example.title: Coronado Point condominiums: shingle-style bay-front block

brief: A 1990s shingle-style condominium building on the bay: cream siding, stacked glassed balconies under red-brown gabled and hipped roofs with dormers and chimneys, a pergola and pool lawn behind a white fence. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
